description: Position sizing: measure how much of a token the chain ACTUALLY lets you trade - entry and exit across every configured venue at a ladder of USD sizes, per-size impact and round-trip cost, plus the largest size under your cost tolerance. Ask BEFORE choosing a position size. Costs $0.05 per call.

chainId.description: REQUIRED. 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. There is no default; omitting it returns 400 missing_chain.

sizesUsd.description: Ladder of sizes in USD, max 6 (default 100, 1000, 10000, 100000)

tokenAddress.description: Token you plan to buy (symbol or 0x address)

name: get_trade_depth
